svg.aria-label: Limitations: Research ratios are averages per project type, not verdicts on individual projects or companies. Project types without a published ratio (62% of tonnes) are not scored. Registry beneficiaries can be resellers or brands rather than the claimant. Company-reported and independent emissions

g.text: Research ratios are averages per project type, not verdicts on individual projects or companies. Project types
without a published ratio (62% of tonnes) are not scored. Registry beneficiaries can be resellers or brands rather
than the claimant. Company-reported and independent emissions use different boundaries and are never merged. Full
